acip: GSAL CHA DANG DVANGS CHA NI YUL LA MI BYED PAR, YUL CAN SHES PA LA GSAL CHA'AM DVANGS CHA YOD MED LA BYA DGOS, GSAL CHA MI 'BYUNG BA'I TSE SGRIB BYED KYIS SGRIB PA LTAR YOD,
wylie: gsal cha dang dvangs cha ni yul la mi byed par, yul can shes pa la gsal cha'am dvangs cha yod med la bya dgos, gsal cha mi 'byung ba'i tshe sgrib byed kyis sgrib pa ltar yod
english: It's important to say here that—when we talk about clarity, or clearness—we're not talking about a quality of the object. Rather, it's a distinction that you have to make about the subject state of mind in meditation: does the mind itself feel clear—is there mental clarity, or not? When we can't get clarity to come, it feels almost like we've moved under a dark shadow.
